collector.registration: Dormant four-premise Maryland CityHive pickup cohort; eight merchant-scoped queries are capped at 50 seconds. Montgomery County ABS remains an independent MD-MONTGOMERY aggregate source and is not included in Maryland retailer inventory.

storeIdentity.proof: Each source response must reparse its exact merchant configuration, physical address, city and coordinates. Only current exact 750 mL library identities with a positive first-party pickup option qualify; reported stock remains binary, and every alert and delivery channel is disabled.

sourceSemantics.availability: Binary retailer-published pickup availability at the four reviewed premises. Positive options do not establish exact shelf counts.

stateFilter.assertion: Maryland-wide exact-store coverage remains dormant until the source-scoped first-publication receipt is verified.

finder.assertion: The four exact Maryland premises must be returned by public Finder without absorbing Montgomery County aggregate data.

monitoring.assertion: MD retailer inventory and MD-MONTGOMERY aggregate rows are measured and published as separate partitions.

alerts.assertion: Retailer pickup rows remain informational and all inventory, watch, email, SMS, and delivery channels remain disabled.

production.assertion: Verify independent MD exact-store and MD-MONTGOMERY aggregate partition counts, current source clocks, and the source-bound immutable first-publication receipt before admission.
